item.title: 10 Movie Endings That Changed the Game
item.description: A good ending does more than just wrap up a story, it leaves the audience guessing and wanting more, often influencing decades of filmmaking to follow. Whether through a shocking twist, moral ambiguity, or structural experimentation, these finales shifted the cinematic landscape in measurable ways. item.title: Photos Remembering What it Was Like to Be a Nerd in the ’70s & ’80s
item.description: Before geek culture went more mainstream, being a nerd in the 1970s and 1980s meant living a very different lifestyle than it does today. It entailed afternoons spent hunched over graph paper mapping dungeons, feeding quarters into arcade machines, debating starship schematics, or programming in BASIC on a beige home computer.
